layout.fallback: If the button does not open, copy this link into your browser:
layout.footer: Penaria at {server} sent this message automatically. Replies to it are not read.

test.subject: Penaria: test email
test.title: Outgoing mail works
test.lead: This is a test email from Penaria at {server}. If you are reading it, the install can send email: sign-in links, password resets and invitations will reach people.

email_verification.subject: Confirm your email for Penaria
email_verification.title: Confirm your email
email_verification.lead: {name}, confirm that {email} is your address. Penaria will send password resets and notices about your account there.
notes: If you did not add this address to an account in Penaria, ignore this email: nothing changes until the address is confirmed.

password_reset.subject: Reset your Penaria password
password_reset.title: Reset your password
password_reset.lead: {name}, someone asked to reset the password of the account {username}. Open the link to choose a new password.
notes: If it was not you, ignore this email: your password stays as it is.
A new password signs you out on every device. Your passkeys keep working.

invitation.subject: {inviter} invites you to {home} in Penaria
invitation.title: You are invited to {home}
invitation.lead: {inviter} invites you to the home {home} in Penaria as {role}. Open the link to accept with your account, or to make one.
notes: The invitation works once. If you do not know {inviter}, ignore this email.

password_changed.subject: Your Penaria password was changed
password_changed.title: Your password was changed
password_changed.lead: {name}, the password of the account {username} was just changed, and every other device was signed out.
notes: If it was not you, reset the password at once from the sign-in page, or ask the admin of your home for a reset link.

passkey_added.subject: A passkey was added to your Penaria account
passkey_added.title: A new passkey
passkey_added.lead: {name}, a passkey named “{passkey}” was just added to the account {username}. It signs in without a password.
notes: If it was not you, sign in, remove the passkey on the account page and change your password.

email_changed.subject: The email of your Penaria account was changed
email_changed.title: Your email was changed
email_changed.lead: {name}, the email of the account {username} is now {email}. Password resets and notices go there from now on.
notes: If it was not you, sign in at once, change your password and set your own address again, or ask the admin of your home for a reset link.

email_removed.subject: The email of your Penaria account was removed
email_removed.title: Your email was removed
email_removed.lead: {name}, this address is no longer the email of the account {username}. Password resets and notices no longer come here.
notes: If it was not you, sign in at once, change your password and add your address again, or ask the admin of your home for a reset link.

totp_enabled.subject: Two-step sign-in is on for your Penaria account
totp_enabled.title: Two-step sign-in is on
totp_enabled.lead: {name}, signing in to the account {username} with the password now also asks for a code from your authenticator app.
notes: Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe: each one replaces a code once if you lose your phone.
If it was not you, someone knows your password: reset it from the sign-in page, or ask the admin of your home for a reset link.

totp_disabled.subject: Two-step sign-in is off for your Penaria account
totp_disabled.title: Two-step sign-in is off
totp_disabled.lead: {name}, the authenticator app of the account {username} was turned off. Signing in with the password no longer asks for a code, and the recovery codes no longer work.
notes: If it was not you, sign in at once, change your password and turn two-step sign-in on again.

recovery_code_used.subject: A recovery code was used for your Penaria account
recovery_code_used.title: A recovery code was used
recovery_code_used.lead: {name}, a recovery code was just used instead of a code from the authenticator app of the account {username}. Each code works once. Recovery codes left: {left}.
notes: If you lost your phone, set up the authenticator app again on the account page. If you are running out of codes, make new ones there.
If it was not you, someone has your password and your recovery codes: sign in, change your password and make new recovery codes.

recovery_codes_regenerated.subject: New recovery codes for your Penaria account
recovery_codes_regenerated.title: New recovery codes
recovery_codes_regenerated.lead: {name}, new recovery codes were just made for the account {username}. The earlier ones no longer work.
notes: If it was not you, sign in at once, change your password and make new recovery codes.
